Is AP EAMCET Results 2026 Released?

Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (AP EAMCET/AP EAPCET) is a state-level entrance exam conducted by the Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), Kakinada to select candidates for admission into undergraduate engineering, agriculture and pharmacy courses at various colleges in Andhra Pradesh. All those candidates who appeared for the examination between 12th May and 20th May 2026 are now looking for the outcome of their hard work. So this is to inform them that the AP EAPCET 2026 Result are scheduled to be released on 01st June through the official portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET. It is to be noted that only those candidates who successfully clears the written test will only be considered eligible for the document verification process.

How to Check AP EAMCET Result 2026 at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET?

All those candidates who appeared for the Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (AP EAMCET/AP EAPCET) can now access their online score cards by simply following the step-by-step shared below:

Step 1: Firstly, visit the official Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), Kakinada, website.

Step 2: Look for latest updates section on the top of homepage.

Step 3: Click on “AP EAMCET Result 2026” PDF download Link.

Step 4. Enter your application number and password.

Step 5: Carefully fill out the CAPTCHA code and click on download button.

Step 6: At the end, make sure you download and save your AP EAPCET results for future use.

What’s Next After AP EAMCET Entrance Exam Result 2026?

After the announcement of AP EAMCET (now AP EAPCET) 2026 results, all those candidates who have successfully qualified the exam will be called for counselling and admission process conducted by the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE). The next step include counselling registration, payment of the processing fee, certificate verification, web-option entry for preferred colleges and branches, seat allotment and reporting to the allotted institute within the prescribed timeline. Students should keep important documents ready, including their rank card, hall ticket, Class 10 and 12 certificates, income and caste certificates (if applicable) and residence proof. Detailed counselling schedule will soon be updated on the official APSCHE website.

Answer: Official results for AP EAMCET entrance test 2026 are scheduled to be announced on June 01, 2026.

Q2. Where will AP EAPCET scorecard PDF download link be displayed?

Answer: AP EAPCET scorecard PDF download link will be activated at the official website – cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET.

Q3. Will I require any login credentials to access my EAMCET Result 2026 AP?

Answer: Yes, to download EAMCET scorecards AP candidates neet to enter their respective application number and password as login credentials.

Q4. Who is responsible for conducting AP EAPCET exam 2026?

Answer Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), Kakinada, on behalf of APSCHE conducts AP EAMCET entrance Test 2026.
